title.note: Game title, glossary keep; the guide keeps Latin brand and title names and adds no Khmer title without the owner's OK.
title.blind_remark: left in English, Latin script; not translated

hud.cast.note: 'Throw the line', the angler's phrase (សន្ទូច = hook and line), not a spell. 7 of 8 by lint, 9 code points in one run: check the round button; បោះ alone is the fallback.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull!' -- what you do when a fish bites; same verb as the pass ទាញស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form 'Bait: {count}' with the Khmer colon ៖; reads right for 0, 1 and 12. នុយ = fishing bait.

hud.backpack.note: Guide vocabulary: backpack / inventory = កាបូប (bag).
hud.backpack.blind_remark: the word also commonly means wallet or purse; not specifically a backpack

catch.success.text: ស្ទូចបានហើយ! {fish}ថ្នាក់{rarity}!
catch.success.note: 'Caught it! A {rarity}-class {fish}!' -- guide pattern {pet}ថ្នាក់{rarity}, e.g. ត្រីកាបមាសថ្នាក់កម្រ. Split into two exclamations so the long space-free run gets a break after !; អ្នក dropped.

catch.escaped.text: ត្រីរបូតបាត់ហើយ...
catch.escaped.note: 'The fish slipped away...' -- uses the generic ត្រី as the context allows; របូត = slip out of a hold.

catch.new_record.text: កំណត់ត្រាថ្មី! {weight} គីឡូក្រាម
catch.new_record.note: កំណត់ត្រា = record (as in បំបែកកំណត់ត្រា, break a record). kg written out in Khmer as គីឡូក្រាម; Latin 'kg' or the spoken គីឡូ are the alternatives.

fish.golden_carp.text: ត្រីកាបមាស
fish.golden_carp.note: ត្រីកាប = carp (the Khmer fish-farming name) + មាស 'gold', modifier after the noun; reads ត្រីកាបមាសថ្នាក់កម្រ in catch.success. Unverified how well kids know ត្រីកាប.

fish.lantern_eel.text: អន្ទង់ចង្កៀង
fish.lantern_eel.note: អន្ទង់ = eel, ចង្កៀង = lamp / lantern: 'lamp eel' keeps the glowing-lantern idea. គោម (paper lantern) is closer to 'lantern' but says 'light' less clearly. Base form, no classifier.

rarity.mythic.note: 'Myth' (stories of gods), one tier above Legendary = រឿងព្រេង ('legend, folktale'), so gods outrank folk legends. Reads អន្ទង់ចង្កៀងថ្នាក់ទេវកថា in catch.success. Unverified whether kids read it as higher; ទិព្វ ('divine') is a shorter alternative.
rarity.mythic.blind_remark: the noun 'myth/mythology', not an adjective like 'mythic'; inside catch.success it reads 'myth class'

shop.rods.note: Fishing rod (ដង = pole, សន្ទូច = hook and line); Khmer needs no plural on a tab.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' -- a rod is held, not worn (ពាក់), so the bare verb ប្រើ; pairs with the label កំពុងប្រើ.

shop.equipped.note: 'In use' (aspect marker កំពុង): a state, paired with the ប្រើ button.

shop.free.note: Guide vocabulary: free = ឥតគិតថ្លៃ. 7 of 8 by lint.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide reference pass.buy_price; ដោយ ('with') stops it reading as 'buy {price} Robux'.

pass.auto_reel.text: ទាញស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ
pass.auto_reel.note: 'Pull automatically', same verb as hud.reel; ស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ is the everyday word for automatic. 11 of 14 by lint but 16 code points with no space: check the card width. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: នុយសំណាង បង្កើនឱកាសស្ទូចបានត្រីកម្រ ទ្វេដង!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Lucky Bait doubles the chance of catching rare fish' (ទ្វេដង = twofold); 'your' dropped. Khmer bold likely does not show (guide), so the pass name must read fine unbolded.

sell.all.text: លក់ទាំងអស់

sell.done.text: លក់ត្រី {count} ក្បាល បាន {coins} កាក់!
sell.done.note: 'Sold {count} fish, got {coins} coins!' -- fish counted with the classifier ក្បាល; Khmer has no plural forms, so it reads right for 1.

sell.prompt.text: ចុច E ដើម្បីលក់
sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern ចុច E ដើម្បី...; E kept Latin. Source-side: ActionText 'Sell' would serve phone and console players too.

ascend.button.note: 'Rise in rank' -- the prestige sense, not religious and not climbing. Avoids ឡើងថ្នាក់ (ថ្នាក់ is the house rarity word) and ឡើងកម្រិត (level up). Same word in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: ចង់ឡើងឋានៈឥឡូវនេះទេ? អ្នកនឹងចាប់ផ្ដើមពីដំបូងវិញ ប៉ុន្តែនឹងស្ទូចបានត្រីកម្រ ញឹកញាប់ជាងមុន {bonus}%។
ascend.confirm.note: Modeled on the guide's rebirth.confirm ('Want to ... now?'); 'start over' = start again from the beginning; '{bonus}% more often' = ញឹកញាប់ជាងមុន {bonus}%. No 'permanently' added, as the source has none.

weather.storm.text: ព្យុះកំពុងមកដល់! ត្រីកម្រកំពុងស៊ីនុយ!
weather.storm.note: 'biting' = ស៊ីនុយ 'taking the bait', the fishing sense. The second sentence ends in ! instead of ។ to keep the banner excited, as the guide allows.

quest.title.note: Guide vocabulary: quest = បេសកកម្ម; no plural needed.

quest.catch_n.text: ស្ទូចត្រីឲ្យបាន {n} ក្បាល នៅឈូងពន្លឺខែ
quest.catch_n.note: 'Fish until you have {n} at Moonlight Bay'; classifier ក្បាល, fine for 1. Moonlit Bay = ឈូងពន្លឺខែ ('moonlight bay', terms.json), a coined place name; English in-world signs would not match it.

quest.claim.note: Guide reference reward.claim: 'take it'; never ទាមទារ (legal claim).
quest.claim.review_reason: On a quest panel ទទួលយក reads as 'Accept', as if taking on a new quest (the blind back-translation read it that way); យករង្វាន់ 'take the reward' says what the button does and fits the 10 budget.

friends.boost.text: ស្ទូចត្រីជាមួយមិត្តភក្តិ បានសំណាង +{percent}%
friends.boost.note: 'Fish with friends, get +{percent}% luck' -- a statement, so no ដើម្បី; + kept and % attached as in Khmer number style.

trade.sent.text: បានផ្ញើសំណើដោះដូរទៅ {player}
trade.sent.note: 'Sent a trade request to {player}'; no ។ because the English has no final period.

trade.accept.text: {player} បានយល់ព្រមដោះដូរជាមួយអ្នក
trade.accept.note: '{player} agreed to trade with you' -- the request was accepted; Khmer has no gender to agree.

codes.enter.note: Guide reference codes.placeholder; never លេខសម្ងាត់ (password).

codes.redeemed.text: ប្រើកូដបានជោគជ័យ! រីករាយជាមួយរង្វាន់។
codes.redeemed.note: 'Code used successfully! Enjoy the reward.' -- avoids បានប្រើកូដហើយ, which can read as the error 'code already used'; possessive dropped; ។ for the English period.

afk.kicked.text: អ្នកនៅស្ងៀមយូរពេក ដូច្នេះបានឈប់ស្ទូចត្រីហើយ។
afk.kicked.note: 'You stayed idle too long, so fishing has stopped'; ដូច្នេះ ('so') states the cause. No mention of leaving the server, as in the source.
afk.kicked.blind_remark: who stopped the fishing is left implied; reads as if you stopped it yourself

settings.back.note: 'Return' -- closes the panel; ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ also works but is 8 of 8 by lint and 11 code points.

settings.sfx.text: បែបផែនសំឡេង
settings.sfx.note: 'Sound effects' (effect + sound), the counterpart of តន្ត្រី (music) on the same panel; dictionary spelling សំឡេង.

event.ends.text: ចប់ក្នុង {time} ទៀត
event.ends.note: Guide pattern 'in {time}' -> ក្នុង {time} ទៀត. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters; Khmer players need '2 ថ្ងៃ 4 ម៉ោង' (CLDR).

daily.streak.text: ចូលលេងជាប់គ្នាថ្ងៃទី {day}! ត្រឡប់មកវិញថ្ងៃស្អែក ដើម្បីបានរង្វាន់ថែមទៀត។
daily.streak.note: 'Playing in a row, day {day}!' -- the ordinal ថ្ងៃទី {day} reads right for 1; 'for more' made explicit as more rewards; ។ for the English period.

tip.night.text: គន្លឹះ៖ ត្រីខ្លះស៊ីនុយ តែពេលយប់ប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
tip.night.note: គន្លឹះ = tip; ស៊ីនុយ = bite (take the bait); space before តែ gives a wrap point.

group.join.text: ចូលរួមក្រុមរបស់យើង ដើម្បីបាននុយ 50 ឥតគិតថ្លៃ!
group.join.note: Guide pattern social.group_reward; ក្រុម = Roblox group. Bait counted bare like a currency, no classifier.
group.join.review_reason: Khmer has no article, so bare ក្រុម loses 'the' and can read as 'join a team'; ក្រុមរបស់យើង names the studio's group, as in the guide's social.group_reward.

leaderboard.biggest.text: ត្រីធ្ងន់ជាងគេ
leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish' -- the board ranks by weight, so ធ្ងន់ (heavy) rather than ធំ (big).
